text: {"lessons":["My account has moved up and down even when I made no trades, so I should expect some fluctuation and avoid reacting to every monthly change.","Selling Stocks B and C at losses did not prevent the account from rising the next period; I should base sell decisions on risk and prospects, not just on my purchase price or recent losses.","Because these savings help fund my retirement, I should trade deliberately, keep enough cash for flexibility, and avoid taking risks I cannot comfortably afford."]}
